The Meridian desk shelf is cut from a single walnut board, so the grain runs unbroken from one leg to the other. It lifts a 27-inch monitor to a comfortable eye line and leaves room underneath for a full-size keyboard.

Every shelf is finished by hand with a plant-based hardwax oil that can be refreshed at home rather than sent back to us.
